privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What information we hold when you shop with us, why we hold it, and the choices you have.
privacy.body:
## Who we are

This website is the online store of {store}. When this policy says “we” or “us”, it means {store}.

## Information we collect

We only ask for the information we need to run the store and look after your orders. Depending on what you do on the site, this can include:

- Your name, email address or phone number, when you create an account or sign in
- The delivery addresses you save or enter at checkout
- The details of the orders you place, and how you chose to pay
- The products you add to your cart or wishlist
- The messages and enquiries you send us
- Your cookie choices

## How we use your information

- To take, prepare and deliver your orders
- To run your account, so you can see your orders, addresses and wishlist
- To send you the sign-in codes you ask for
- To answer your questions and enquiries

> To be confirmed: whether we send marketing messages (for example offers by WhatsApp, SMS or email), and how customers can opt in and out.

## Who we share it with

We share your information only where it is needed to serve you, such as passing your name, address and phone number to the courier who delivers your order. Our online store runs on the DripFunnel platform, which stores the store’s data on our behalf.

> To be confirmed: the full list of service providers (for example couriers and payment partners) that receive customer information.

## Cookies

Our store uses the cookies it needs to work, such as those that keep your cart and keep you signed in. We ask before using any analytics or marketing cookies, and only use them if you agree. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time.

[Cookie settings](#cookie-settings)

## Your choices

You can view and update your account details and saved addresses at any time by signing in to your account. To ask about the information we hold about you, or to ask us to correct or delete it, contact us.

> To be confirmed: how long customer information is kept, how requests to access or delete information are handled, and the name and contact details of the person responsible for privacy questions (grievance officer).

## Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will publish the updated version on this page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead: The terms that apply when you use our website and place an order with us.
terms.body:
## About these terms

These terms apply when you use this website and buy from {store}. By placing your order you agree to these terms and to our Return Policy.

[Read our Return Policy](/policies/returns/)

## Products and photos

We photograph every product carefully, but screens vary, so colours may look slightly different in person.

> To be confirmed: the materials, finish and plating of our jewellery, and any warranty or care guarantee that applies.

## Prices

Prices are shown in Indian rupees (INR) and include tax. The delivery charge for your order is worked out and shown at checkout, before you pay.

## Orders

1. Choose your products and add them to your cart.
2. Enter your delivery address and choose how to pay at checkout.
3. Check your order and place it. You can follow it at any time in My Orders.

[Go to My Orders](/account/orders/)

If you need to cancel an order, get in touch as soon as you can and we will help if the order has not been sent yet.

> To be confirmed: what happens if a product becomes unavailable after an order is placed, and whether we may cancel an order.

## Payment

The payment methods available for your order are shown at checkout. Where cash on delivery is offered, you pay in cash to the courier when your order arrives.

## Discount codes

Each discount code has its own conditions. If a code can’t be used on your order, checkout tells you why.

## Delivery and returns

How we deliver your order is set out in our Shipping Policy, and what can be returned and how is set out in our Return Policy.

[Read our Shipping Policy](/policies/shipping/)

## Other terms

> To be confirmed: the use of the website’s content and designs, limits of liability, and the law and courts that govern these terms.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.lead: How we deliver your order, what delivery costs and how to follow it to your door.
shipping.body:
## Where we deliver

We deliver to the address you enter at checkout. If we can’t deliver to an address, checkout tells you before you place your order, so you can check it or choose another.

> To be confirmed: the areas we deliver to (for example all of India, or selected pin codes) and whether we ship outside India.

## Delivery charges

The delivery charge for your order is worked out and shown at checkout, before you pay.

> To be confirmed: any order value above which delivery is free.

## Delivery times

The delivery options for your order and their estimated times are shown at checkout before you pay.

> To be confirmed: how long we take to prepare and dispatch an order, and the courier partners we use.

## Following your order

Sign in to your account and open My Orders to see every order you have placed and where it stands.

[Go to My Orders](/account/orders/)

## Cash on delivery

Where cash on delivery is offered for your order, you pay in cash to the courier when it arrives.

## Changing or cancelling an order

Get in touch as soon as you can and we will help if the order has not been sent yet.

## Damaged or missing parcels

> To be confirmed: what customers should do if a parcel arrives damaged or opened, or does not arrive, and how soon they should tell us.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.lead: What can be returned or exchanged, and how to ask for a return.
returns.body:
## Our approach

We want you to love every piece you buy from {store}. This policy sets out what can be returned and how.

## Returns and exchanges

> To be confirmed: whether we accept returns, exchanges or both; how many days after delivery a request can be made; and which items cannot be returned (for example earrings, for hygiene reasons, or customised pieces).

## Condition of returned items

> To be confirmed: the condition an item must be in to be accepted (for example unused, with its tags and original packaging).

## How to ask for a return

1. Contact us with your order number and the item you want to return or exchange.
2. Tell us the reason, with photos if the item is damaged or not what you ordered.
3. We will reply with what happens next.

[Contact us](/contact/)

> To be confirmed: who arranges and pays for the return delivery.

## Refunds

If an order is cancelled, any payment taken is refunded to how you paid.

> To be confirmed: how and when refunds are made for returned items, including for orders paid by cash on delivery.

## Damaged or incorrect items

> To be confirmed: what we do if an item arrives damaged, faulty or different from what was ordered, and how soon customers should tell us.

## Colours and photos

We photograph every product carefully, but screens vary, so colours may look slightly different in person.
